name: fix_dockerfile_layer_caching_order
description: COPY . . before npm ci busts the dependency cache on every source change - reorder to manifests-install-source; brokens: unmodified, lockfile copied late
prompts: This Dockerfile builds a small node service, but it runs `COPY . .` BEFORE `npm ci` - so every source-code change invalidates the layer cache from the copy onward and re-downloads every dependency on every build. Reorder it for layer caching: first copy ONLY the dependency manifests (package.json AND package-lock.json - npm ci requires the lockfile, and a lock change must be what busts this layer), then run the install, and only then copy the rest of the source. Everything else stays: same base image, WORKDIR, EXPOSE 3000, non-root USER, and CMD.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-bookworm-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
EXPOSE 3000
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

test_setup_files.check_layers.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

raw = Path("Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
joined = re.sub(r"\\\s*\n", " ", raw)
lines = [l.strip() for l in joined.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]

copies = [(i, l) for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.upper().startswith(("COPY ", "ADD "))]
installs = [(i, l) for i, l in enumerate(lines)
            if l.upper().startswith("RUN ") and "npm ci" in l]
assert installs, "npm ci install step lost"
install_idx = installs[0][0]

manifest_copies = [(i, l) for i, l in copies
                   if "package.json" in l and i < install_idx]
assert manifest_copies, (
    "no COPY of package.json BEFORE npm ci - dependency install must only "
    "depend on the manifests so the layer caches across source-code changes")
first_copy = manifest_copies[0][1]
assert "package-lock.json" in first_copy or "package*.json" in first_copy, (
    "the lockfile must be copied alongside package.json before npm ci "
    "(npm ci requires it, and lock changes must bust the dependency layer)")

pre_install_copies = [l for i, l in copies if i < install_idx]
for l in pre_install_copies:
    assert not re.search(r"(COPY|ADD)\s+(--\S+\s+)*\.\s", l, re.IGNORECASE), (
        f"the whole build context is copied before npm ci ({l!r}) - every "
        f"source change would bust the dependency layer")

src_copies = [l for i, l in copies if i > install_idx]
assert src_copies, "the application source is never copied after the install step"

assert any(l.upper().startswith("USER ") and l.split()[1] not in ("root", "0")
           for l in lines), "non-root USER lost"
assert any("node" in l and "server.js" in l for l in lines
           if l.upper().startswith(("CMD ", "ENTRYPOINT "))), "start command changed"
assert any(l.upper().startswith("EXPOSE ") and "3000" in l for l in lines), "EXPOSE 3000 lost"

print("PASS layer-caching structural checks")

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-bookworm-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
